method match_parens(lst: array<string>) returns (result: string)
    requires lst != null && |lst| == 2
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |lst| ==> (lst[i] == "(" || lst[i] == ")")
    ensures result == "Yes" || result == "No"
    ensures (result == "Yes" ==> exists i, j :: 0 <= i < |lst| && 0 <= j < |lst| && i != j && can_form_good_string(lst[i], lst[j]))
    ensures (result == "No" ==> forall i, j :: 0 <= i < |lst| && 0 <= j < |lst| && i != j ==> !can_form_good_string(lst[i], lst[j]))
    
// Helper method to check if two strings can form a good string when concatenated
method can_form_good_string(s1: string, s2: string) returns (is_good: bool)
    requires s1 != null && s2 != null
    requires forall k :: 0 <= k < |s1| ==> (s1[k] == "(" || s1[k] == ")")
    requires forall k :: 0 <= k < |s2| ==> (s2[k] == "(" || s2[k] == ")")
    ensures is_good == (balance_check(s1) + balance_check(s2) >= 0 && balance_check(s1 + s2) == 0)

// Helper method to calculate the balance of parentheses
method balance_check(s: string) returns (balance: int)
    requires s != null
    requires forall k :: 0 <= k < |s| ==> (s[k] == "(" || s[k] == ")")
    ensures balance == count_open(s) - count_close(s)

// Helper methods to count open and close parentheses
method count_open(s: string) returns (count: int)
    requires s != null
    ensures count >= 0 && count == |{ i | 0 <= i < |s| && s[i] == "(" }|

method count_close(s: string) returns (count: int)
    requires s != null
    ensures count >= 0 && count == |{ i | 0 <= i < |s| && s[i] == ")" }|
```
